name: Swear Filter
description: Adds a filter to Geometry Dash.

enable-replacements.name: Enable Replacements
enable-replacements.description: Attempts to <cy>replace</c> censored words with more-appropriate alternatives.

strict-mode.name: Strict Mode
strict-mode.description: Censors words outside the word-boundary (e.g. "class" would be filtered as "cl***").

relax-censor.name: Relax Result
relax-censor.description: Exposes the first and last characters of the censored word.

censor-level-names.name: Censor Level Names
censor-level-names.description: Whether or not to censor <cg>level names.</c>

censor-level-descriptions.name: Censor Level Desc.
censor-level-descriptions.description: Whether or not to censor <cg>level descriptions.</c>

censor-song-names.name: Censor Song Names
censor-song-names.description: Whether or not to censor <cg>song names.</c>

censor-text-objects.name: Censor Text Objects
censor-text-objects.description: Whether or not to censor <cg>text objects</c> in a level (not in the editor).

replacement-character.name: Replacement Character
replacement-character.description: The character to use for replacing censored words.
